claims.object_text: generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus (GEFS(+))
claims.quote: Mutations in the NaV1.1 neuronal sodium channel alpha-subunit (SCN1A) gene have been documented in a spectrum of epilepsy syndromes, ranging from the relatively benign generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus (GEFS(+)) to severe myoclonic epilepsy in infancy (SMEI), and rare cases of familial migraine.
